'''Coleman Kcaj''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] 
during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kcaj was appointed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], serving as early as circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Jedi Master===
Following years of [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|tension]] between the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the conflict came to a head on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] with the capture of Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Under the leadership of [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], Master Kcaj was part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] that landed around the [[Petranaki arena]] on an extraction mission. Storming the arena, Kcaj fought along his brother and sister Jedi, including fellow [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] Jedi [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]], cutting down countless [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Surviving the conflict, Kcaj returned to the Jedi Temple and accepted the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the newly created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

[[File:ColemanKcaj.png|thumb|left|250px|Holographic representation of Coleman Kcaj on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]]]

===Jedi High Council===
After nearly two years of fighting, circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Master Kcaj was approached by the Jedi leadership and offered a seat on the Jedi High Council. He would help shape the Republic war effort for the remainder of the conflict.

Shortly after his ascension to the Council in 20 BBY, Kcaj attended a session of the High Council where the holographic form of Admiral [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] addressed the High Council. At that time, fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] had [[Escape from the Republic military base/Legends|escaped]] Republic captivity and had been [[Capture of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|re-captured]] to be put on trial. The Admiral went on to suggest what would happen to her, and once the transmission ended, this generated debate between [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].

[[File:JediCouncil-Conspiracy.png|235px|thumb|Coleman attending the council meeting discussing the current situation with [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].]]
Some months later, Kcaj participated via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] when the High Council reviewed reports of a clone trooper who murdered the Jedi Master [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]] and was being assessed for mental illness or defection to the enemy. The Council eventually concluded that the specialists at the Temple were best equipped to investigate the clone's condition.<ref name="Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref>

Later, the deceased Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]' ship was found by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. During a Council meeting, Koon presented the [[Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], worrying the Council.<ref name="TLO">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> Then, Obi-Wan Kenobi revealed that during his [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] investigation, it was Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas that ordered the production of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]], without the consent of the council or the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Mace Windu then revealed that Dyas had sat on the council years prior to the war and Kcaj's appointment, but was removed because his ideas were judged too extreme.<ref name="TLO" /> Later, Kcaj and the rest of the Council were informed by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker after the [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)/Legends|death]] of [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] that it was [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] that had the clones created. Windu then said that if this had gotten out into the public, then all respect towards the Jedi, the Republic, and the war would disappear, causing mass chaos, so, Kcaj and the Council were forced to keep this new development secret.<ref name="TLO" /> Sometime later, Kcaj was present when the Council meditated with Yoda, but could not hear the voices that the elderly [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] could. After this, [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] started to become suspicious and pointed out that the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] could be using Yoda to destroy the Jedi Order.<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

====Fall of the Jedi====
Shortly following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battle over Coruscant]], Kcaj attended a performance of [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']] at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]], where he was seen speaking with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]] shortly before the show.<ref name="QA" />

In the following days, Jedi Anakin Skywalker was appointed to the High Council by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], an unprecedented move that disturbed the Council. Not long after this event, the Chancellor was revealed to be the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, the orchestrator of the entire war, and the puppet master of both the Republic and the Confederacy. The majority of the High Council was killed in what became known as the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="ROTS" />

===Legacy===
With the Jedi Order disbanded and its members hunted to near extinction, all traces of Kcaj disappeared. In the junk heaps of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], the diminutive Knight [[Kazdan Paratus]] succumbed to insanity, building a [[Junk Temple|replica]] of the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Filling the junk edifice with puppets of his peers, Paratus filled the seats of his makeshift [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] with a replica of each Councilor, including Kcaj. Spending years among the puppets, Paratus was eventually hunted down in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]. During their confrontation, Paratus manipulated the puppets with the Force, ordering them to attack the assassin. Chopping through the Kcaj puppet just as he did the others, Starkiller slew Paratus and left the replica Temple to crumble.<ref name="TFU">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Coleman Kcaj was created as a Master on the Jedi High Council for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. A completely CGI rendered figure, his model was created based on an altered version of Jedi [[Pablo-Jill/Legends|Pablo-Jill]]. Named [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the name was later changed and Concorkill became the name of a [[Vurk/Legends|Vurk]] Senator also seen in the film.<ref name="QA" /> Revised in the ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'', the image of Kcaj was replaced with the correct depiction of Concorkill.<ref name="Insider 102">{{InsiderCite|102|Ask Lobot}}</ref> The name Coleman Kcaj, is in reference to [[Rob Coleman]]'s son, Jack, with Kcaj being the reversed spelling of Jack.
